title: axy's Sapling Seeds
description: Turns saplings into tree seeds (in a more stylistic sense than a realistic sense)
body:
## Sapling Seeds
![A market stall showcasing the new sapling seed textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f608d0776b20dacf6dd3b4099a32d0895872bab.png)
###  So what does this texture pack do?
This texture pack changes saplings to look like tree seeds so they actually make sense for once! When these seeds are planted on the ground, a patch of dirt appears in place of the usual sapling block model, similar to how farmland looks!

> "While a good bit of research went into how the tree seeds look, note that they are not completely accurate to any of the trees' real life counterparts. These are more stylistic than they are realistic. Hope that clears things up :)"
**— axy 💙**

**NOTE:** This pack has a 3D variant if you prefer it, just go to the Versions tab and download the latest 1.x.x_3d version.

###  Additional details
- This pack is expected to work as intended for versions beyond 1.20.x
- This pack may or may not be subject to errors on **versions below 1.20.x** 
- Mods are not required to use this pack
- Submit a support request on my ⚙️ [Discord server](https://discord.gg/HZbvM2KBnR) if you encounter any issues
